summary: Backend Engineer with 4 years of experience building reliable APIs and high-scale backend systems in Python, Node.js, and PHP/Laravel, including sole ownership of a government mobile API platform (500+ app downloads, 8M+ portal visitors) that passed STQC security testing. Cloud-exposed across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud; skilled in payment gateway integration (Stripe, Razorpay, PhonePe) with idempotent transaction processing, Laravel queue-based asynchronous workflows, and WordPress/plugin security remediation, including a public open-source vulnerability fix. Currently a backend developer at Forvis Mazars, an MNC; previously served as a dedicated engineer for Blueastral's products via Bitstreaks, translating client requirements into POCs for both entities while leading Bitstreaks' internal team of junior developers.
